FortiADC-KVM # config load-balance pool
  edit "LAB_POOL_SMTP"
    set health-check-ctrl enable
    set health-check-list LAB_HC_SMTP
    set real-server-ssl-profile NONE
    config  pool_member
      edit 1
        set pool_member_service_port 25
        set pool_member_cookie rs1
        set real-server RS_A
      next
      edit 2
        set pool_member_service_port 25
        set pool_member_cookie rs2
        set real-server RS_B
      next
      edit 13
        set status disable
        set pool_member_service_port 2525
        set pool_member_cookie rs13
        set real-server NETOPS_TEST_ADC_POOL_MEMBERS_IP
      next
    end
  next
--More--          end
